title: Smoother updates
notes: The rarest looks have a fresh style: Void Prismatic, Shiny Void, Shiny Prismatic, Shiny Void Prismatic and Shiny Gilded each look brand new.
Updates are now hands-off: when the game restarts to update, every window steps aside and only the update card shows until it’s done.
Supporters with a Mythic trainer pick waiting get a one-time reminder, with a button straight to the picker.
fixes: Your money and Bag now reach the server on every sync, so a long idle session is never set back to an older amount, and Mythic Shop buys go through right away.
Big PCs sync with the server even faster.

title: Golden Leaf and Mythic trainers
notes: Golden Leaf festival (14 to 28 Nov): a bingo board shuffled just for you, mystery blocks, acorn openings, encore quests once your board is full, a Leaf Calendar stamp for every festival day, the Autumn Album, Harvest Moon nights and costume spotlights.

Mythic trainers: supporters can pick an original Mythic trainer outfit, one more for each month of support (up to 3). They show on your card, the leaderboards and everywhere else your trainer appears.
Animated PC wallpapers now move smoothly at your chosen frame rate.
changes: Mirage now passes on in the Day Care, but only from a Mirage parent: a Mirage egg is about as rare as finding a Mirage in the Safari Zone. A pair with a Mirage parent shows its chance on the Day Care’s Mirage chip.
Sound effects and Cries now have separate switches in Settings → Sound.
With a Poké Radar chain, the odds tooltip shows the chained Pokémon’s odds and everyone else’s separately.
You can unfavourite a Pokémon right in the Prism Altar, Night Market and auction pickers (it asks first).
The Battle Tower battle window stays where you dragged it, floor after floor.
Raid replays now end the moment the boss is beaten, instead of playing out the rest of the battle.
fixes: The Prism Altar now fits on phones (and scrolls on small ones). The Calendar fits on a phone held sideways.
The egg card no longer runs off the top of the screen in Classic.
Battle Tower: a Master Ball never “breaks free” any more. If a Hard Mode throw doesn’t go through, you’re told why and you keep the ball.
Mythic Shop: if a buy can’t go through yet, it now says your wallet is still syncing instead of “The shop just changed”.
Browser (especially Safari): if the browser’s storage gets stuck at start, your save is never replaced by a cloud copy or a New Game, and the game tells you what’s wrong instead of a general error.

Browser: if the save on your account is more than 2 days old, it’s no longer loaded on its own. The game shows how old it is first (the Tallgrass app on your Dock or home screen and each browser keep their own save).
Cloud saves upload more reliably on slow connections and on older Safari versions.
If you also play Tallgrass Offline, the New Game screen reminds you that your Offline game is still saved. The two always keep separate saves.
Big PCs now sync with the server much faster.
Nothing gets cut off on small Mac windows, and a trackpad swipe turns one page.

title: Aurora wallpaper fix
fixes: Fixed: the animated Aurora wallpaper now ripples properly instead of sliding down like a waterfall.
